subject.title: [Bug]: Docker Install + Sandbox can't workspaceAccess at all

question: What host-path mapping contract should OpenClaw support for Docker Gateway/DooD sandbox bind sources?
rationale: The bug is clear, but the fix changes the sandbox host-path exposure boundary and the Docker operator setup contract, so automation should not choose the security/product policy alone.

options.title: Guarded automatic remap
options.body: Map OpenClaw-managed sandbox bind sources through the Gateway container mount table, then validate mapped sources against allowed roots and reserved-target rules before Docker receives them.

options.title: Document host-path parity only
options.body: Keep runtime paths container-local and make Docker setup/docs/doctor require identical host/container workspace mounts instead of adding remapping behavior.

options.title: Explicit operator prefix map
options.body: Add a narrow config or env mapping for advanced Docker operators, accepting the extra configuration surface and migration/docs burden.

recommendation.title: Guarded automatic remap
recommendation.body: Map OpenClaw-managed sandbox bind sources through the Gateway container mount table, then validate mapped sources against allowed roots and reserved-target rules before Docker receives them.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the canonical cluster signal and have the strongest recent overlap across sandbox mount and Docker setup paths.
